Room 12 bed B, Mrs. Weber, 82, hip fracture post-op day 2. BP 145/85, HR 92, temp 38.2 C at 06:00, SpO2 94% on 2L O2. Pain 6/10 when moving.
Paracetamol 1 g oral given 05:30. Refused breakfast, only a few spoons of yogurt.
Sacrum slightly red, repositioned every 2h. Confused overnight, tried to get out of bed twice, bed alarm on.
Please recheck temp at 10:00 and call the doctor if above 38.5. Wound dressing change due today.
